decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding (target_index 0) correctly identify Green (2011) in Applied Neuropsychology (18, 18-26) as the replicated original study. Although the abstract refers to 'Green (in press)', the Introduction, Results, Discussion, and References explicitly identify the single-author Green (2011) disability-claimants study comparing the TOMM and NV-MSVT.

decisions.quote:
In the current study consisting of individuals diag-

nosed with disorders primarily related to anxiety,

depression, and chronic pain, Green’s (201 1) data were

very closely replicated. As with the Green (2011) study,

more than twice as many patients failed the NV-MSVT

compared with the TOMM.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding rate the replication outcome as 'successful'. The authors state an explicit overall verdict in both the Abstract ('Overall, results closely matched those of the Green (in press) study and extend the evidence that the NV-MSVT possesses better sensitivity to poor effort than the TOMM') and the Discussion ('Green’s (201 1) data were very closely replicated'), confirming both the higher failure rate on the NV-MSVT relative to the TOMM and the paradoxical profile (Criterion B1) among examinees failing the NV-MSVT while passing the TOMM.
